title: ConfigMutationOutput
description: The acknowledgements `duckduckgo-search-cli config set` and `config unset` write on stdout. Both carry `type: "config_mutation"` (v1.0.4+) so the published catalog can route them, and are told APART from each other by `action`, which is why this file keys its `oneOf` on `action` — the same pattern `deep-research-error.schema.json` uses with `error`. The routing key for this family is therefore the PAIR (`type`, `action`). Added in v1.0.3 (GAP-SCHEMA-INTROSPECTION-UNDECLARED-001); `type` added in v1.0.4, when the whole `config` family turned out to be unroutable. English-only: configuration key names are part of the CLI contract.

config_file.description: File the write landed in. The write is atomic, so on success this path holds the new value.

value.description: Value as stored, echoed verbatim. A caller can compare it against what it sent to detect normalisation.

removed.description: False when the key was already absent. Unsetting an unset key is not an error, so the exit code alone cannot tell the two apart — this field can.
